units.source_text: 阿泷穿上和服出席旅馆的酒会，她的身材虽然高大得足以一把摁住客人的胸膛，那双明亮闪光的眼睛却使客人魂牵梦萦。

en.t: A-Taki wore a kimono to attend the inn's drinking party; although she was so tall and strongly built that she could press a guest against the chest with one hand, her bright, sparkling eyes left the guests utterly enchanted.
